tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open third round wraps Saturday — Alcaraz beat Wu 6-3, 6-4, 6-1 and Medvedev rolled through on Friday; Sabalenka, Pegula and Navarro advance as round-of-16 play begins Sunday • [SQUASH] London Classic semi-finals at Alexandra Palace — Paul Coll faces Eain Yow Ng, Marwan ElShorbagy meets Victor Crouin; Hania El Hammamy vs Georgina Kennedy and Sivasangari Subramaniam vs Amina Orfi • [BADMINTON] China Masters semi-finals in Shenzhen — An Se-young faces Akane Yamaguchi; Satwik-Chirag meet Azriyn-Wee Kiong; Goh-Shevon challenge world No. 1 Feng-Huang • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals semi-finals in Cary — singles and mixed doubles from 9am ET on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel; Championship Sunday tomorrow • [TABLE TENNIS] HYLO Champions League Stage 2 Round of 16 draw set — Saarbrücken vs Lille Metropole among eight ties; Europe Cup men and women group-stage draws completed

newsItems.title: London Classic Semi-Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Gold London Squash Classic reaches the semi-final stage at Alexandra Palace — Paul Coll faces Eain Yow Ng and Marwan ElShorbagy meets Victor Crouin, while Hania El Hammamy takes on Georgina Kennedy.

newsItems.title: China Masters Semi-Finals Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The Super 750 in Shenzhen enters the final four — An Se-young faces Akane Yamaguchi, Malaysia has two men's doubles pairs in the semis, and Goh Soon Huat-Shevon Lai challenge world No. 1 Feng Yanzhe-Huang Dongping.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Reach Semi-Finals
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Major in Cary moves into semi-final Saturday with singles and mixed doubles from 9am ET — PickleballTV and Tennis Channel carry live coverage ahead of Championship Sunday.

newsItems.title: Champions League Stage 2 Draw Set
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026/27 HYLO ETTU Champions League Men Round of 16 is set after Stage 1 in Lille — 1. FC Saarbrücken face Lille Metropole among eight ties, as Europe Cup group-stage draws were also completed.
